sections.title: The same -ni, more verbs
sections.content: You already form the infinitive by adding *-ni* to the stem: *olvas → olvasni*, *főz → főzni*, *sportol → sportolni*. The hobby verbs work the same way: *fut → futni*, *táncol → táncolni*, *kirándul → kirándulni*, *néz → nézni*, *hallgat → hallgatni*. The ending never changes with vowel harmony. Verbs in *-ik* drop the *-ik* first: *úszik → úszni*, *focizik → focizni*.

sections.title: Irregular ones
sections.content: A few verbs are irregular. You know *enni* (to eat) and *inni* (to drink). The same group has *menni* (to go) and *jönni* (to come): they do not follow the stem.

items.english: I would like to go hiking.
I would like to go to the cinema.

sections.content: Drop the *-ik* before *-ni*: *úszni*, never *úszikni*. And *menni* and *jönni* must be learned as they are, like *enni* and *inni*.
